name: Krevo Ricik

facts.text: Level 73, 30,000 health. When attacked he may (15%) raise a 'forgoten ghost'; he throws his attacker 400 units into the air; casts Dark Explosion.

story: Krevo Ricik is an ogre who discovered that the dead of Krondon are afraid of him, and he has made a trade of it. He walks the passages where the hall's ghosts drift and drags them out to fight for him, forgotten things with no names left, and when a challenger comes too close he seizes him and flings him at the roof. The ogres find him funny. The ghosts do not. They come when he calls because they cannot remember how to refuse, and when he dies they drift back to the walls of Krondon as if nothing had happened, which for them is nearly true.
legend: He throws you straight up and the floor does the rest; land it, heal it, get back in. Every time you hit him there is a chance a forgotten ghost rises to help him. Kill the ghosts as they come, keep the heals going, and keep the casters out of his reach.

phases.text: Get up, dead thing! Fight for Krevo!

death: The dead... laugh at me now...

lairEntry: The ghosts here keep to the walls. Something scares them.

phases.text: Krevo Ricik drags a forgotten ghost into the fight!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Krevo Ricik is dead. Krondon's ghosts are left in peace.
